🔗 Enhanced Links_Enabled.name: Link effects
🔗 Enhanced Links_Enabled.tooltip: Off draws native ComfyUI links and leaves every other link setting as it is.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Static_Mode.name: Freeze link animation
🔗 Enhanced Links_Static_Mode.tooltip: Keep the look but stop the motion.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Link_Style.name: Link path shape
🔗 Enhanced Links_Link_Style.tooltip: Same as ComfyUI follows the Link Render Mode setting.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Physics_Profile.name: Wire physics
🔗 Enhanced Links_Physics_Profile.tooltip: Wires sag and swing; works with any animation, including None.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Particle_Density.name: Link particle density
🔗 Enhanced Links_Particle_Density.tooltip: How many particles or markers each link carries.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Physics_Amount.name: Wire physics strength
🔗 Enhanced Links_Physics_Amount.tooltip: How far wires sag and swing: 0 keeps the native shape, 2 is twice the profile.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Primary.name: Link primary color
🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Primary.tooltip: Used when Link colors is Custom.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Secondary.name: Link secondary color
🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Secondary.tooltip: Used when Link colors is Custom.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Accent.name: Link accent color
🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Accent.tooltip: Used when Link colors is Custom.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Scheme.name: Link color boost
🔗 Enhanced Links_Color_Scheme.tooltip: Filter applied on top of the colors.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Blend.name: Glow blending
🔗 Enhanced Links_Blend.tooltip: Additive glow lets the moving effects brighten where they cross, on dark palettes; light palettes and canvas background images always use Normal.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_Enabled.name: Flow markers
🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_Enabled.tooltip: Shapes gliding along links in Classic Flow, and in the other animations with Markers on every animation.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_All.name: Markers on every animation
🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_All.tooltip: Flow markers over every link animation, not only Classic Flow.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_Color_Mode.name: Marker color
🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_Color_Mode.tooltip: Same as link follows custom link colors.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_Color.name: Marker custom color
🔗 Enhanced Links_Marker_Color.tooltip: Used when Marker color is Custom.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Link_Shadow_Enabled.name: Link shadow
🔗 Enhanced Links_Link_Shadow_Enabled.tooltip: Dark outline under links in Classic Flow, which makes them stand out.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Shadow_Style.name: Shadow style
🔗 Enhanced Links_Shadow_Style.tooltip: Halo is the soft dark outline v1 drew; Drop shadow is offset, as in v2.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Assist_Mode.name: Connection assist
🔗 Enhanced Links_Assist_Mode.tooltip: While you drag a link, show the nearest slot it can connect to.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Enabled.name: Node effects
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Enabled.tooltip: Off draws native ComfyUI nodes, with no effects, halos, particles, styled titles or completion effects, and leaves every other node setting as it is.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Animate.name: Node effect
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Animate.tooltip: Effect drawn on and around every node. Node FX in the node menu picks one for a node.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Animations_Enabled.name: Show base effect
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Animations_Enabled.tooltip: Off draws only the effect's own particles.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Animation_Glow.name: Node effect bloom
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Animation_Glow.tooltip: Glow of the effect's lines and light, and of the hover outline.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Glow_Show.name: Node effect glow
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Glow_Show.tooltip: A halo in the effect's primary color around each node with an effect.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Glow.name: Node glow strength
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Glow.tooltip: How far the halo and the selection frame glow.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Hover_Show.name: Hover outline
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Hover_Show.tooltip: Outlines animated nodes while hovered or selected.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Primary.name: Node primary color
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Primary.tooltip: Used when Node effect colors is Custom.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Secondary.name: Node secondary color
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Secondary.tooltip: Used when Node effect colors is Custom.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Accent.name: Node accent color
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Accent.tooltip: Used when Node effect colors is Custom.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Scheme.name: Node color boost
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Scheme.tooltip: Filter applied on top of the colors.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Particle_Show.name: Node particles
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Particle_Show.tooltip: Also drawn when Node effect is None.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Particle_Color_Mode.name: Node particle colors
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Particle_Color_Mode.tooltip: Particle color takes Node particle color with Custom colors, else the effect's primary color; Complementary takes its opposite hue.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Particle.name: Node particle color
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Color_Particle.tooltip: Used when Node effect colors is Custom.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Text_Animation_Enabled.name: Animated titles
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Text_Animation_Enabled.tooltip: Draws each node title in the chosen style.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Text_Color.name: Title color
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Text_Color.tooltip: Used when Node effect colors is Custom; otherwise titles take the effect's accent color.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Text_Rotation_Radius.name: Title orbit radius
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Text_Rotation_Radius.tooltip: Circles the title around its position.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Focus_Enabled.name: Selection focus
🔗 Enhanced Links_Focus_Enabled.tooltip: Make the selection's connections stand out.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Focus_Hover.name: Focus on hover
🔗 Enhanced Links_Focus_Hover.tooltip: Hover a node to focus it without selecting.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Navigate_DoubleClick.name: Double-click a slot to jump
🔗 Enhanced Links_Navigate_DoubleClick.tooltip: Fly to the other end; repeat to cycle.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Navigate_Follow.name: Follow execution
🔗 Enhanced Links_Navigate_Follow.tooltip: Pan to each node as your run reaches it.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Pause_Mode.name: During a run
🔗 Enhanced Links_Pause_Mode.tooltip: Reacts to your own runs only.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Flow_River.name: Data river
🔗 Enhanced Links_Flow_River.tooltip: Light flowing into the running node.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Flow_Trail.name: Executed-path trail
🔗 Enhanced Links_Flow_Trail.tooltip: The run's path keeps a fading glow.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Run_Ring.name: Progress ring
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Run_Ring.tooltip: Ring fills with the node's progress.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_End Animation_Enabled.name: Effect when a run finishes
📦 Enhanced Nodes_End Animation_Enabled.tooltip: Plays the Completion style when your run succeeds.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Completion_Style.name: Completion style
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Completion_Style.tooltip: Path trace runs a comet along the links your run took; Surprise plays another style each time.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Completion_Anchor.name: Completion anchor
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Completion_Anchor.tooltip: Mark primary nodes in the node menu.

📦 Enhanced Nodes_Completion_PerNode.name: Burst when each node finishes
📦 Enhanced Nodes_Completion_PerNode.tooltip: Sparks pop from the corner of each node on screen as your run finishes it.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Perf_MaxFps.name: Effect frame-rate cap
🔗 Enhanced Links_Perf_MaxFps.tooltip: The most redraws a second that moving effects ask for. Display rate asks for one with every frame the display shows.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Perf_Adaptive.name: Adaptive quality
🔗 Enhanced Links_Perf_Adaptive.tooltip: While frames take half as long again as the frame-rate cap or the display allows, link glows go plain, then particles thin out, then effects hold still, a step a second; they come back after 5 seconds or more with room.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Perf_StaticAbove.name: Freeze above N visible links
🔗 Enhanced Links_Perf_StaticAbove.tooltip: Link motion holds still while more animated link segments than this are on screen (a link through reroutes has one per stretch), and Nodes 2.0 glows while more than a quarter as many animated nodes are. 0 never freezes.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Motion.name: Motion
🔗 Enhanced Links_Motion.tooltip: Follow system shows effects still while the system, or ComfyUI's Disable animations, asks for less motion. Reduce always shows them still; Full always animates them.

🔗 Enhanced Links_Coexist.name: Other link extensions
🔗 Enhanced Links_Coexist.tooltip: When another extension, such as LinkFX, draws links too. Stepping aside leaves the links to it; node effects keep working.

options.Step aside if one is found: Step aside if one is found
